 Through :- None for R-1 to 3.
 Mr. Anishwar Chatterji Koul, CGSC for R-4 & 5.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MOHD.
YOUSUF WANI, JUDGE  ORDER 27.05.2025
1. On mention, the matter is taken up out of turn.
2. Respondents 4 & 5 have not filed their reply in the matter.
They are directed to file the same by the next date of hearing.
Appearance of respondents 1 to 3 is awaited in the ends of justice.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners in respect of CM Nos.1154/2025 & 3256/2024, in which the prayer has been made for release of the award amount without prejudice to the rights of the petitioners to be determined in the writ petition.

Also heard Mr. Anishwar Chatterji Koul,
learned CGSC for respondents 4 & 5 in rebuttal.
4. Perused the applications supported with an affidavits.
5.
Considered the rival submissions of the learned counsel for the parties.

6. Through the medium of the instant writ petition, the petitioners have sought for passing of direction/Writs in the nature of Mandamus regarding their claim for entitlement to compensation in accordance with The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text:
It is pleaded by the petitioners that the award in their case was passed on 16.12.2020 after the application of the Act 2013 to the Union Territory of Jammu Darshan Kumar And Others vs Union Territory Of J&K And Others on 27 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98699668/
1

entities.text: Union Territory of Jammu Darshan Kumar And Others vs Union Territory Of J&K And Others on 27 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: and Kashmir

, owing to which fact, the Collector concerned was required as per the provisions of Section 24 of the Act of 2013 to determine the compensation as per the scheme of the new Act which has not been done.

7. This Court is of the considered opinion that it may meet the ends of justice, if both the applications are allowed and respondents 2 & 3 are directed to release under rules the compensation amount as per the impugned Award dated 16.12.2020 in favour of the petitioners without prejudice to their rights to be adjudicated in the pending petition.
8. It is accordingly ordered.
9. Both the applications, are accordingly, disposed of.
10. List the main petition on 06.08.2025.
